entries.subject: DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys DR10 color HiPS
entries.finding: A 3000 x 3000 px hips2fits cutout of CDS/P/DESI-Legacy-Surveys/DR10/color, 35.1 arcmin wide on the 2MASS position. Color from four bands, public with acknowledgment, and addressed by one URL. Its sky subtraction ends M49's light about 560 arcsec out.

entries.subject: Burrell Schmidt Deep Virgo Survey mosaics (Mihos et al. 2017)
entries.finding: The survey behind M87's ESO image publishes B and Washington M mosaics at 1.45 arcsec per pixel (337 and 372 MB) that cover M49 to far fainter light than the Legacy Surveys composite. Not used: the lab recipe reads a published display image by URL, and these are calibrated FITS mosaics that need a cutout, a stated display transfer and a local-input route. The page asks users to cite the survey paper and to tell the team how the data are used; it states no licence.
entries.revisitWhen: The lab recipe can read a prepared local image, or the outer halo is wanted.

entries.subject: SDSS DR9, Pan-STARRS DR1 and DSS2 color HiPS
entries.finding: Looked at as 900 px previews of the same field on 2026-10-01. SDSS shows its frame mosaic as dark squares around M49, DSS2 is photographic and shows the galaxy only to about 3 arcmin, and Pan-STARRS subtracts the galaxy's own light as sky, leaving a dark ring about 1.5 arcmin out.

entries.subject: Catalogue for the neighbour masks
entries.finding: RC3 lists 8 galaxies in the field and misses VCC 1254, VCC 1167 and VCC 1152, which then stayed in the image as blobs. HyperLEDA PGC (Paturel et al. 2003) lists 61 with a D25 within 0.5 degrees; the 29 whose masks reach the cutout are masked.

entries.subject: Filling a mask inside the galaxy
entries.finding: M87's fill, the median of the light around the mask, left dark holes at NGC 4467 and UGC 7636, which lie inside M49's light. Taking the light opposite through the centre copied a survey artefact east of the core and failed where two masks face each other. The median of the unmasked light on the pixel's isophote left no hole.

entries.subject: Spheroid
entries.finding: Kormendy et al.'s own Table 1 fit to NGC 4472 (n = 5.99, r_e = 269.29 arcsec, major axis) is used as published; no fit was made here.

entries.subject: Globular cluster catalogues
entries.finding: Jordán et al. (2009), the ACS Virgo Cluster Survey catalogue, for the Hubble field (765 with pGC >= 0.5) and Côté et al. (2003) for clusters with velocities out to 567 arcsec (263). M87's package uses Peng et al. (2009) and Strader et al. (2011), which cover M87 only.
